task_name: Place and Construct First Residential Zone

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: Immediately after connecting the first road when the Residential Zone icon displays a '1' badge and the advisor prompts to build housing.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Building the first Residential Zone establishes initial population (52 Sims), generates starting Simoleons (+880) and XP (+10), and unlocks commercial crafting.
preconditions: Residential Zone available in the right-hand menu
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place the Residential Zone directly adjacent to the road inside the designated yellow tutorial boundary.

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: drag the Residential Zone onto the highlighted area beside the road.
confirm placement of the first Residential Zone.

steps.who: yellow hard hat bubble above the Residential Zone
steps.briefing: open the construction material requirements for the zone.
drag the required Metal onto the Residential Zone to build the first house.
